issue: Does the Brady due process disclosure requirement apply to evidence that is material only to a pretrial motion to suppress?

sides.position: Brady extends to evidence material to a motion to suppress
cases: United States v. Gamez-Orduño, 235 F.3d 453 (9th Cir. 2000)

sides.position: Brady does not reach evidence material only to a motion to suppress; the Tenth Circuit has hinted at this view but has not held it
cases: United States v. Muhtorov, 20 F.4th 558 (10th Cir. 2021)

quote: Although some courts have extended Brady to evidence that is material to suppression
cite: United States v. Muhtorov, 20 F.4th 558 (10th Cir. 2021)
